title: Vision-language model (Qwen3-VL)
summary: On-device multimodal LLM: ask questions about photos (describe, OCR, count, compare, read labels) or plain text chat, with token streaming. Runs fully offline after a one-time download.
limits: One-time download: 2B ≈ 1.6 GB, 4B ≈ 3 GB (4B needs 8 GB+ RAM). Always show progress and ask before downloading (use the models recipe).
Must be loaded into memory before asking (a few seconds).
Slower than cloud models: keep maxTokens small (100–300) and images ≤ 1280 px.
Stateless: send the whole conversation each time.
